title: OPS-02 Multi-Scene Dataset Expansion Campaign Master Specification
purpose: Authoritative machine-readable specification governing the design, acquisition, ingestion, QC, partitioning, and provenance tracking for the OPS-02 multi-scene dataset expansion campaign.
core_principles: Increase independent physical scene diversity and representation quality, NOT merely slice count.
A class with 100 tiles from 1 parent scene represents 1 degree of freedom, not 100.
Partitioning must occur at the parent scene cluster level BEFORE slicing.
Strict separation between raw authoritative imagery and deterministic derived tiles.
Absolute prohibition of training during C12.

scientific_questions.Q1: Does increasing independent parent-scene diversity (from 27 to >= 60-120) improve cross-parent generalization and eliminate single-scene memorization artifacts?
scientific_questions.Q2: Does broader acquisition-condition diversity (balanced Ascending/Descending, varied wind/sea states) reduce catastrophic parent-specific representation collapse (such as Parent Scene 01)?
scientific_questions.Q3: Does increasing rare-class parent diversity (>= 8 independent scenes per class) materially improve tail-class feature learning and overcome zero-IoU failure modes?
scientific_questions.Q4: Does multi-basin geographic diversity and multi-season temporal breadth enhance model stability across global maritime operational environments?
scientific_questions.Q5: Does broader physical context and explicit lookalike mapping resolve ambiguity between morphologically confusable SAR phenomena (e.g., BS vs LWA vs Eddy)?

geographic_ontology.rule: Never collapse marginal seas into generic basins without recording the specific regional sea. Record both hierarchical levels.

temporal_acquisition_policy.distribution_requirement: Acquisitions must be distributed across all four meteorological seasons and at least 3 distinct calendar years. No single calendar quarter may contain > 35% of acquisitions.

sensor_representation_specification.sensor: Sentinel-1 C-band (5.405 GHz) Synthetic Aperture Radar
sensor_representation_specification.polarization_priority: Primary: VV (co-polarized); Secondary: VH (cross-polarized dual-pol where available)
sensor_representation_specification.product_level: Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) in Interferometric Wide (IW) swath mode
sensor_representation_specification.runtime_input_definition: Uncalibrated 10x10 spatial aggregation of detected Digital Numbers (DN-domain representation), log1p transformed, standardized by TRAIN statistics.
sensor_representation_specification.terminology_invariant: Must be cited as 'SAR-derived detected DN-domain representation'. Never casually cite as sigma0 or calibrated backscatter unless calibration LUTs have been applied.

lookalike_and_anthropogenic_strategy.lookalike_role: BS, LWA, and IWs serve as critical natural dark-feature look-alikes to mineral oil slicks. They must be preserved with distinct class labels to build future false-alarm suppression capabilities.
lookalike_and_anthropogenic_strategy.hm_role: HM is preserved strictly as canonical 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects'. Future vessel attribution and kinematic tracking will be implemented as an auxiliary multi-task detection/tracking layer, without mutating the 12-class EXP-07 segmentation taxonomy.

annotation_tiers.TIER_A: Expert manual pixel segmentation with documented peer-review / cross-validation. (TRAIN, DEV, HOLDOUT eligible)
annotation_tiers.TIER_B: Trusted semi-automated pipeline with specialist manual verification. (TRAIN, DEV eligible)
annotation_tiers.TIER_C: Reconstructed annotations from legacy archives with documented lineage. (TRAIN eligible only)
annotation_tiers.TIER_D: Weakly supervised, bounding box only, or unverified model pseudo-labels. (STRICTLY QUARANTINED)

technical_raster_checks: Valid GeoTIFF raster format readable by GDAL / rasterio
Single-band float32 or uint16 matching expected dimensions
Zero NaN, Inf, or negative non-fill pixels in imagery
NoData / out-of-swath pixels correctly masked to 0 / ignore_index
Mask pixel dimensions strictly match image dimensions (256x256)
All mask values in range [0, 11] or equal to ignore_index (-100)
Source SHA256 and derived SHA256 cryptographically verified

stop_and_quarantine_conditions: Discovery of ambiguous or unverifiable parent scene provenance.
Spatial overlap > 5% between a candidate scene and any existing DEV or HOLDOUT parent.
Conflation of mineral oil spills with biogenic slicks or ocean fronts.
Annotation tier dropping to Tier D.
Loss of raw Level-1 product traceability.

brute_force_mandatory: Pairwise SHA256 hash collision checking across all image and mask files.
Exact product identifier string comparison against all historical OPS-01 products.
100% verification of technical raster QC constraints on every single candidate tile.
safe_optimization_allowed: Spatial overlap checking: Use bounding box R-tree spatial indexing / geospatial blocking to prune candidate pairs before executing full O(N^2) polygon intersection geometry.
Proof of safety: A minimum bounding box (MBB) filter is guaranteed to contain no false negatives; any pair whose MBBs do not intersect cannot have polygon intersection.
